candidate.title: Then I Love a Nobody
candidate.hook: Catherine sneers, 'Your soldier?' and Juliana immediately corrects her: 'My husband.'
candidate.cliffhanger: After Juliana says Catherine has never made anyone love her, Catherine breaks and screams, 'Why?!'
candidate.sinker_question: Why won't Juliana stop confronting Catherine despite the threat of the hot iron?
sinker_answers: She wants Catherine to expose herself
She has nothing left to lose
She is defending her husband's dignity
candidate.why: The romance-versus-status argument steadily strips away Catherine's confidence until she cracks.

candidate.title: Thrown Away for Him
candidate.hook: A dramatic chord hits as an enraged man lunges forward and shouts that the bride has thrown herself away.
candidate.cliffhanger: The family matriarch answers the bride's defiance by formally disowning her.
candidate.sinker_question: Will the bride abandon the penniless man to preserve her family and status?
sinker_answers: Choose her husband and accept exile
candidate.why: The furious accusation is more immediately confrontational than the wedding pronouncement while retaining the same ultimatum.

candidate.title: Going Somewhere
candidate.hook: A fleeing aristocrat opens a church door and finds a sardonic police constable waiting outside.
candidate.cliffhanger: After the accusations reveal why he ran, the promo returns to his face frozen before the waiting constable.
candidate.sinker_question: Can the cornered lord escape the conspiracy closing around him?
sinker_answers: He is arrested on the spot
He betrays his partners for immunity
He reveals who truly ordered the false death report
candidate.why: The cold open presents the satisfying trap first, then rewinds to build the evidence and betrayal that forced him to flee.

candidate.title: Crawl for His Life
candidate.hook: A smiling woman tells her own sister, "I want to see you crawl."
candidate.cliffhanger: She demands that her sister tear through frozen thorns with bare hands—or watch her husband hang.
candidate.sinker_question: What will she choose when saving her husband means sacrificing her own hands?
sinker_answers: Accept the ordeal and search for the ring
Refuse and trust her husband to face the law
Let her husband stop her from going
Expose the cruel bargain as a trap
candidate.why: Cutting before she accepts turns the visceral ordeal into a genuine choice with multiple believable outcomes.
